name: Coquette
for: Ribbon-and-lace romance. The softest door in the drawer, and the one most people open first.
holds: Bows, ribbons, lace, hearts, pearls, roses, scent bottles, fans, hair ornaments

name: Cottagecore
for: A kitchen garden in sticker form. Warm, edible, unhurried.
holds: Botanical plates, mushrooms, baskets, hens, wheat, fruit, jugs, bees, herbs

name: Fairycore
for: The woodland floor at dusk. Serves Pinterest's Wilderkind straight out of the box.
holds: Butterflies, moths, dragonflies, ferns, mushrooms, moons, beetles, nests, feathers

name: Dark Academia
for: The library at 2am. Serves Poetcore. The only free pack with a live class-9 trademark on its name.
holds: Bookplates, pens, keys, inkwells, spectacles, globes, moths, laurel, ornament initials

name: Victorian Scrap
for: The actual Polyvore ancestor: die-cut scrap out of a real scrapbook. Serves Pen Pals and Brooched.
holds: Die-cut scrap, cherubs, hands, fans, silhouettes, trade cards, stamps, wreaths, doves

name: Romantic Goth
for: Mourning jewellery and ironwork. The half of goth that museums actually hold.
holds: Ravens, skulls, moths, ironwork, mourning jewellery, bats, serpents, urns, thorns

name: Art Deco
for: 1925 geometry. Serves Neo Deco, and it is the one pack that is mostly line rather than object.
holds: Chevrons, sunbursts, cigarette and vanity cases, deco jewellery, stepped ornament, enamel

name: Balletcore
for: Ribbon, rosin and stage light. The thinnest of the free eight and the one most helped by a Rijksmuseum key.
holds: Slippers, ribbons, tulle, roses, opera glasses, garlands, programme ephemera, drapery

name: Y2K
for: 2003 plastic and chrome. The riskiest pack we will ever ship, which is why it is the proving batch.
holds: Butterfly clips, flip phones, chrome hearts, stars, glitter gel, holographic film

name: Soft Kawaii
for: Pastel cartoon sweetness, drawn well away from anything Sanrio owns.
holds: Cute faces, stars, clouds, bows, bubble lettering, pastel blobs

name: Modern Goth
for: The hardware half of goth. Where Romantic Goth is mourning jewellery, this is chain and spike.
holds: Spikes, chains, barbed wire, crosses, smudge and scratch marks

name: Grunge
for: Flash-photo edges and torn flyers. Museum newsprint sits underneath it for free.
holds: Tape, film burn, flash edges, torn flyers, scribble, halftone

name: Hot Pink
for: Glossy plastic maximalism. Named Hot Pink on purpose: the obvious name is Mattel's.
holds: Glossy plastic shapes, bubble type, sparkle bursts, heart sunglasses

name: Holo
for: Holographic and opalescent. Serves Extra Celestial and Cool Blue.
holds: Holographic gradients, opal shimmer, moons, stars, prisms
